in_sanskrit.name: जयन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय (Jaya) - Victory, न्त (Natha) - Lord; A name for a boy meaning 'Lord of victory'

in_hindi.name: जयन्त्
in_hindi.long_meaning: जय (Jaya) - विजयी (Vijayee) - Victor, न्त (Nath) - परमात्मा (Paramatmaa) - Supreme soul, स (Sa) - Son; A name for a boy meaning 'Son of the supreme soul, the victor'

in_tamil.name: ஜயன்ஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜயம் (Jayam) - விக்கியம் (Vikkiyam) - Victorious, ஷ (Sha) - Son; A name for a boy meaning 'Victorious son'

in_telugu.name: జైయఞ్ష
in_telugu.long_meaning: జై (Jai) - విజై (Vijai) - Victor, ఞ్ష (Nyaasa) - Son; A name for a boy meaning 'Son of the victor'

in_marathi.name: Jayansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। God's victory, ruler of the gods
